# HEM 0.6.1b17 — Compact device controls, categorized settings and translation coverage

- **Clean device card:** keep the active per-device control-method selector, diagnostics, Continue Automatic, physical status and compact ON/OFF policy tiles (including opening-window suggestions and error announcements). Advanced operating-mode parameters, PID calibration/model, fan and quiet tuning, and manual targets are no longer repeated on the card.
- **Categorized per-device settings:** open a dedicated dialog from the HEM device settings control. All native managed-device configuration entities are listed by functional category instead of showing a duplicate card above the categories. Each mode's settings remain separately editable; the exact entity/physical-controller identity and authorization checks remain in effect.
- **Correct categorization:** an operating-mode key no longer sends all scoped PID/target/fan settings into the generic Mode category. Native setting names and dropdown values honor provided localized labels, with verified native Home Assistant options preserved for service calls.
- **Clear window announcement:** rename the ON/OFF tile and native switch to **“Προτροπή ανοίγματος παραθύρων για αποφυγή χρήσης αυτής της συσκευής”** and equivalent translations, describing the opt-in outdoor-air alternative before the device starts.
- **All 38 supported locales:** restore missing translations for the upstream supply switch, supply cooldown, startup timeout, and the five Home/Comfort/Away/Sleep/Eco dropdown states. An automated translation-completeness test now rejects missing or empty locale values, missing native dropdown states and incomplete window labels.
- **Regression coverage:** browser and logic tests cover compact controls, native mode selection, permission-scoped configuration actions, PID review/approval, categorized settings, live refresh, localized options and no duplicate device panels.

**No changes to the physical control algorithms, automatic safety boundaries, native on/off dwell, authorization, environmental targets, or stored controller identities.**

Install **v0.6.1b17** through HACS/Marketplace, restart Home Assistant to load the updated integration, and reload the HEM card. Check a multi-mode device, an air purifier, and categorized settings before resuming any paused automatic controllers.
